input.summary: The ticket describes a basic feature request to add a button to the helpdesk form view. The description is clear but missing several key details required before development can begin.

missing_info.text: User role that should see the button is not specified
Expected behaviour after button click is not described
No mention of which Odoo module or view is affected

odoo_notes.text: Affects the helpdesk ticket form view
May require an access-rights update for the agent role

estimates.story: As a helpdesk agent I want a button on the ticket form to trigger the configured action.
assumptions: Reuses the existing helpdesk form view
